locations.name: S Para, BR (Novo Progresso)

stretch.basis: stable-forest pixels (forest mask), all exported dates, percentiles 2.0-98.0

locations.notes: NISAR L2 GCOV (provisional) track 2, frame 174, ascending; all 9 dates used, none excluded. Native 20 m, no multilook, gamma0 dB as delivered. One fixed dB stretch for all dates (see stretch). Layers are JPEG-compressed COGs (quality 85) in EPSG:3857; transparent = no data.

locations.name: Rondonia, BR (Porto Velho-Ariquemes)

stretch.basis: stable-forest pixels (forest mask), all exported dates, percentiles 2.0-98.0

locations.notes: NISAR L2 GCOV (provisional) track 60, frame 173, ascending; only the 5 good dates are exported (2026-08-17 to 2026-10-16). The earlier catalogue dates (2026-06-18, 06-30, 07-24) do not show the same landscape as Aug-Oct, and 2026-07-12 is mis-scaled in the source product; CLAUDE.md traces this to a geolocation/processing problem inside the provisional product (cause beyond that unknown), so they are not shown. Window had no alert-confirmed clearing of 1 ha or more on 2026-08-29 to 2026-10-16 (CLAUDE.md, per Pro #1). Native 20 m, no multilook, gamma0 dB as delivered. One fixed dB stretch for all dates. JPEG-compressed COGs (quality 85) in EPSG:3857; transparent = no data.
